opening.argument: The program solicits a Bitcoin-only entry of about $1 while advertising a possible progression to $810,000: "Just $1 in Bitcoin and make $810,000 in Bitcoin." Its structure is not a simple sale; it uses two stages and four levels, with the first level paying $3 divided between an upgrade and profit, and the second stage entered from first-stage profits. The promotion further ties wealth to recruiting and rapid dissemination, stating, "Those who sponsor, will become RICH" and urging viewers to share "as FAST as you can." The staged, forced structure and sponsor-linked payouts are reinforced visually by "3X4 FORCED STRUCTURE," alongside give-get and upgrade prompts. Together, these features present recruitment commissions and tiered matrices rather than an ordinary investment opportunity.
